messages:
Anya: Heads up — after rolling kernel-selection patch (kernel v2) to canary we saw a p99 latency bump on the long tail across a few services.
infra-bot: rolled kernel v2 to canary (canary=10%) at 1769490000
Anya: p95 stayed ~220ms, p99 jumped ~230ms -> ~520ms. Throughput same. KV hit rate dropped from 94% -> 90% during spike.
Mike: Do we have microbatch distribution? Can you paste histogram?
Anya: quick summary: seq<=64 buckets show more single-request dispatches (less coalescing), seq>512 show slightly larger batches. Short seqs exhibit worse tail.
Sofia: Hypothesis: the new kernel path has an extra handshake + cold L2 kernel that adds jitter for small microbatches; scheduler max_wait_ms lets those requests sit and pile up occasionally.
Dave: Also saw KV miss rate bump — priming behavior might be inflating token count per request which changes max_batch_tokens fill patterns.
Anya: Repro command I used locally: `./bin/run-infer --workload=short-seq --clients=200 --profile=kv` — profiler shows ~8ms kernel.handshake + intermittent ~12ms queue spikes.
Mike: Current scheduler config on canary is:
```
scheduler:
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  max_wait_ms: 16
  microbatch_target_tokens: 128
```
Sofia: Proposed short-term experiment: reduce `max_wait_ms` to 8ms for routes with median seq < 128 and add a length-aware decay: wait_ms = max_wait_ms - ceil(seq/32)*2ms (floor at 2ms).
Anya: I ran a 30m canary with that policy on 10% traffic: p99 for short-seq routes dropped from ~520ms -> ~360ms, p95 unchanged. KV hit rate recovered to ~93%.
Dave: What about long sequences? any cost to p95/p99 there?
Anya: Minor regression: p95 for >1024 seqs increased ~10ms, p99 stable. Still within SLO for the affected model.
Mike: Good signal. We should harden with a kernel-fallback guard: if kernel.fallback_count > 0.5% over 5m, force immediate dispatch (bypass wait) for that route to avoid batching-induced fallback storms.
Sofia: Also request adding tracepoints in the runtime for `kv.lookup`, `kernel.handshake`, `queue.waitms` so we can correlate per-token delays in future runs.
Anya: Action items: 
- Mike: implement route-level length-aware `max_wait_ms` override + decay logic (PR)
- Dave: add `kernel.fallback_count` metric + alert at 0.5%
- Sofia: add the three tracepoints to profiler and CI microbench harness
- Anya: run 2h canary with metrics collection and post p95/p99 + KV hit trends
Mike: I'll open the PR and tag @Sofia for review. Will include unit tests covering decay math and boundary cases.
deploy-bot: scheduled: canary rollout of scheduler change to 10% at 1769503000
Sofia: Please include a tiny microbenchmark script in the PR: `scripts/microbatch_sizing.py --seqs 16 32 64 128` so CI can baseline changes.
Anya: Thanks — attaching a short flamegraph snippet (posted separately) and will update thread after the 2h run with numbers and a short write-up.
_note: Single-thread slack conversation string; messages in chronological order. Action items and config snippets included.
